rationale: FindSkia now records the existing Skia-supplies-Dawn decision once as PULP_SKIA_PROVIDES_DAWN (via tools/cmake/PulpSkiaDawnProvider.cmake), and core/render plus the no-editor and render-provider link-floor fixtures read it instead of re-deriving it from DAWN_LIBRARY. This only corrects which WebGPU provider (Skia's Dawn vs wgpu-native) the native link chooses so the two are never linked together; no design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
